title: ERNIE: Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration — Paper Submission
summary: Yu Sun, Shuohuan Wang, Yukun Li, Shikun Feng, Xuyi Chen, Han Zhang, Xin Tian, Danxiang Zhu, Hao Tian, and Hua Wu submitted 'ERNIE: Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration' on April 19, 2019. The paper presents ERNIE as a language-representation model enhanced by knowledge masking strategies, including entity-level and phrase-level masking.
significance: A documented 2019 research milestone for knowledge-enhanced pre-trained language representation, recorded at the paper-submission level without treating that date as the model's invention or development-start date.

verification.note: The authors' arXiv record establishes the title, author list, April 19 2019 first-submission date, and the paper's description of ERNIE as a knowledge-enhanced language representation model using entity-level and phrase-level masking strategies. This candidate records only the paper-submission milestone. It does not infer the model's invention date, development-start date, public software-release date, institutional affiliation, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
